title: Site profile
description: The facts about one machine that a capture run needs: the CARLA server's address, the SUMO installation, and where packages, the catalogue, captures and run records live. Read by carla-capture --site-profile; carla-capture --write-site-profile writes one to edit. A field the file leaves out is derived from the layout the tool runs from.

site_profile_version.description: The format version of this file. A reader refuses any other.

note.description: A note for a person. Not read.

environment.description: The environment variables this profile allows a value to be read from. A value read from a variable the list does not name is reported at launch. Only sumo.home is read from one, CARLANET_SUMO_HOME.

server.description: The CARLA server this machine runs against.

timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the server to answer a request.

sumo.description: The SUMO installation the session launches.

home.description: The SUMO installation to launch, the directory holding bin/sumo. Unset, the session searches SUMO_HOME and then PATH. A relative path is relative to this file. Empty, the launch refuses it (run check 37).

paths.description: Where this machine keeps scenario packages, world packages, the vehicle catalogue, captures and run records.

scenario_root.description: Where compiled scenario packages are found by id. A relative path is relative to this file. Empty or null, the launch refuses it (run check 37).

world_package_root.description: Where world packages are found by the name a scenario lock records. A relative path is relative to this file. Empty or null, the launch refuses it (run check 37).

catalogue.description: The measured vehicle catalogue. Its digest must be the scenario lock's. A relative path is relative to this file. Empty or null, the launch refuses it (run check 37).

capture_root.description: Where captures are written, one directory per session and one per channel inside it. A relative path is relative to this file. Empty or null, the launch refuses it (run check 37).

runs_root.description: Where a run's result, resolution report and lock are written by default. A relative path is relative to this file. Empty or null, the launch refuses it (run check 37).
